spamassassin.description: SpamAssassin plugin configuration settings (Claws Mail plugin section). Must be a mapping; leave empty or set 'enabled: false' to disable plugin loading. All fields under this key are optional unless specified otherwise by real documented behavior in claws-mail-spamassassin(7).

spamassassin.enabled.description: Set to true to load the SpamAssassin plugin (spamassassin.so) at startup. If false, plugin is not loaded.

spamassassin.local_learning.description: If true, use external 'sa-learn' command for training instead of 'spamd' in TCP mode (requires SpamAssassin ≥ 3.1.x).

spamassassin.spam_folder.description: Fully qualified folder path (e.g., 'INBOX.Spam') where spam messages will be moved. If empty or missing, messages go to the default Trash folder.

spamassassin.spamd_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the SpamAssassin daemon (spamd) to connect to. Must be reachable.

spamassassin.spamd_port.description: TCP port on which spamd listens (default 783). Must match spamd configuration.

spamassassin.spamd_timeout.description: Connection timeout to spamd in seconds. Must be ≥ 1.

spamassassin.toolbar_buttons.description: If true, allow toolbar button customization for spam/ham marking.

spamassassin.toolbar_buttons_list.description: List of windows in which to show toolbar spam button. Valid values: ['main_window', 'message_window']. Ignored if toolbar_buttons is false.

spamassassin.toolbar_buttons_list.items.description: One of 'main_window' or 'message_window' to enable spam button in that window.
